messages:
vivian: Quick FYI: Hosted Stream Gateway is GA as of a few minutes ago. This merges streaming + tool-calling into a single endpoint (POST /v1/stream/gateway) and includes a new low-footprint model 'mosaic-slim-v2' tested for sub-1s cold starts on standard GPUs. Docs + migration guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-gateway-ga.

omar: Nice! Will existing customers be auto-switched?

vivian: Existing orgs have a 14-day opt-in period visible in Console. After that we'll start staged auto-migrations with canary routing and a rollback window. Target auto-migrate date: 2026-04-14.

kevin: If teams want early canary keys or higher QPS for validation, DM me. Also note an automatic fallback route to mosaic-pro when model-quality checks fail.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: stream-gateway rollout: canary 10% -> 100% across three regions. No crash alerts. Perf: median p95 within SLO. Logs: https://internal-logs/stream-gateway/1843054321

omar: Any API shape changes or auth differences?

vivian: No auth changes. Minimal schema change: requests now accept an optional "tools" array at top level; streaming payload is identical. SDK patches will be published today to add the gateway helper. Example curl: 
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/gateway \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-slim-v2","stream":true,"tools":[{"name":"search","args":{}}],"input":"summarize: ..."}'
```

kevin: Ops note: alerting updated for gateway-latency and gateway-errors. If you see unexpected 5xx spikes, escalate to #eng-oncall and tag @kevin.

vivian: TL;DR: Stream Gateway GA live, mosaic-slim-v2 available, 14-day opt-in then staged auto-migrations, canary keys from @kevin. Please review the migration guide and SDK changelogs. :tada:
